t: Din tepillin bebet haqqebarot ubebet hammerchatz
s: Din tepillin bebet haqqebarot ubebet hammerchatz ubo g' seipim: asur likkanes betok arba ammot shel met o shel qeber utepillin berosho, mishshum "loeg larash". Ubet haqqebarot shehu muqqap mechitztza — yesh lehachamir shello likkanes betoko kelal bitpillin shebberosho apillu rachoq harbeh min haqqebarot, shemma yitqareb betok arba ammot shel ezeh qeber beli daat. Abal chutz lammechitztza — muttar apillu besamuk lah ap al pi shehu tok arba ammot lehaqqebarot, mippene shehamchitztza mapseqet veeno nireh ke"loeg larash":

Bammeh debarim amurim? Keshehen megullin, abal im hen mekussin — en kan "loeg larash", umuttar bekol inyan. Vetzarik sheggam haretzuot tihyena mekussot. Lepikak ap al pi shemmuttar likkanes bitpillin shel yad lebaddah hoil vehi mekussa — tzarik lizzaher baretzua sheal etzbao shettihyeh gam ken mekussa:

Bebet hammerchatz, babbayit hachitzon shekkol haomedim bo hen lebushim — muttar lehaniach sham tepillin al rosho uzeroo lekattechilla. Ubabbayit haemtzai shemmiqtzat bene adam omedim sham lebushim umiqtzatan arummim — asur lehaniach sham tepillin lekattechilla apillu bishat sheen sham adam arom. Abal im hayu berosho — en tzarik lecholtzan keshenniknas lesham. Ubabbayit happenimi shekkol haomedim bo hem arummim, apillu hayu berosho — tzarik lecholtzan keshenniknas lesham, apillu beshaa sheen sham adam. Bammeh debarim amurim? Bammerchatz shezzuhamato rabba mehebel hachammin shemmishtammeshin bo, abal bebet hattebila ap al pi sheomedim bo arummim, kevan shettashmisho betzonen — en bo zuhama umuttar likkanes bo bitpillin, kesheen sham adam arom. Laken mebarekin birkat hattebila bammiqveh apillu qodem sheyyarad lammayim, ap al pi shellemala mehammayim omedim sham arummim. Abal im yesh sham arom — asur likkanes letoko bitpillin o bishar kitbe haqqodesh, sheasur laamod arom bipne kitbe haqqodesh (velaken tzarik lizzaher lekassot haqqetannim shello yihyu arummim bipne hasseparim, ayyen sop siman arah). (Seliq hilkot tepillin)
